description: Pick repositories by URL, pasted list, organization, user, keyword search, or GitHub topic. Choose the repository metrics and optional language, contributor, commit and release enrichment.

contributorsLimit.description: Maximum ranked contributors to keep when contributor enrichment is on.
contributorsLimit.title: Contributors per repository

includeArchived.description: Turn this off to drop archived repositories from discovery results.
includeArchived.title: Include archived repositories

includeCommitStats.description: Fetch weekly commit activity, participation, code frequency, and punch-card data, up to four extra API requests per repository.
includeCommitStats.title: Include commit statistics

includeContributors.description: Fetch ranked contributors and their contribution counts, up to one extra API request per repository.
includeContributors.title: Include top contributors

includeForks.description: Discovery modes skip forks by default. Turn this on to include forked repositories in organization, user, search, and topic results.
includeForks.title: Include forked repositories

includeLanguages.description: Fetch byte counts per language and compute percentage shares, up to one extra API request per repository.
includeLanguages.title: Include language breakdown

includeReleases.description: Fetch recent releases with tag, date, asset count, and download totals, up to one extra API request per repository.
includeReleases.title: Include releases

language.description: Only return repositories whose primary language matches this name, for example Python, TypeScript, Rust, or Jupyter Notebook. Applied as a GitHub search qualifier where possible, otherwise as a client-side filter.
language.title: Primary language

maxItems.description: Hard cap on repository records. GitHub search itself stops at 1,000 results.
maxItems.title: Maximum repositories

mode.description: One repository, a pasted list of repositories, every public repository in an organization or user account, a keyword search, or a GitHub topic.
mode.title: What to scrape

org.description: GitHub organization login for Organization repositories mode.
org.title: Organization

releasesLimit.description: Maximum recent releases to keep when release enrichment is on.
releasesLimit.title: Releases per repository

repoFullName.description: Repository for One repository mode. Accepts owner/repo, a full https://github.com/owner/repo URL, or the git@github.com:owner/repo.git form.
repoFullName.title: Repository (one repo)

repoFullNames.description: Repositories for A list of repositories mode. Accepts owner/repo strings and full GitHub URLs; duplicates are removed and order is preserved before sorting.
repoFullNames.title: Repositories (list)

searchQuery.description: Keyword search for Keyword search mode. GitHub qualifiers work, for example stars:>1000, language:python, org:vercel, topic:llm, or pushed:>2025-01-01.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order for discovery results. Stars and forks work through GitHub search; created, pushed, and name use the organization/user listing. Keyword-only sort options fall back to recently updated.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

sortOrder.description: Descending (highest or newest first) or ascending.
sortOrder.title: Sort direction

topic.description: Topic slug for Topic search mode, for example machine-learning, web-scraping, or cli.
topic.title: GitHub topic

username.description: GitHub user login for User repositories mode.
username.title: Username

title: GitHub Repository Language Breakdown Analyzer Input
